name: メンバー招待の操作
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE real Lighthouse component LH03-0018「メンバー招待の操作」.
Input roles: Image1 ORIGINAL WhatsApp source controls icon geometry, optical stroke, proportions and fine details. Image2 saved Japanese mock controls Japanese copy, compact logical390x108 layout and text hierarchy only; repair its rough link substitute. Image3 approved bus image is white surface/soft elevation style only; do not include bus content.
ONE white compact rounded list card containing exactly TWO equal-height action rows. Top row: source-faithful thin round-ended plus glyph, exact Japanese label「メンバーを追加」. Bottom row: source-faithful two interlocked rounded chain links tilted bottom-left to top-right, same optical weight as original, exact label「リンクやコードで招待」. Restore original's quiet circular icon backing, adapted to WHITE circles with a fine neutral outline. Slate#526173 for BOTH glyphs; do not copy green skinny mock icons. Original chain proportions and overlap/open interior matter. Labels align to same left edge; two rows separated by one very fine neutral inset horizontal divider beginning under labels. Preserve source's icon-to-label balance and generous usable row target within compact component. No right arrows because these invitation rows in original have none. No member rows, heading, search, group header, phone, QR picture, extra actions or explanatory text.
Typography LOCK: Meiryo Regular14px /24px line-height, tracking0, both exact labels single line; preserve relative scale uniformly if rendered larger. Text#1D1D1D. Do not make labels bold or introduce display headings.
Accent decision: original two rows are equally available neutral invitation alternatives with no selected, online or destructive state. Omit mock's green utility icons; use coherent slate utility icons and white surfaces. No forced green primary button, decorative accent or tinted panels in this fragment. Forest green remains reserved for an actual primary/selected action elsewhere.
Pure white#FFFFFF outer canvas and card, subtle neutral outline, restrained soft downward shadow, modest round corners. Landscape image, entire component centered with modest margins; let its wide two-row compact shape dominate. No clipping. Preserve exactly both Japanese labels and all actual source controls, no invention. This is a static raster design candidate.
reviewNotes: 原画像を主参照として斜めの連結鎖・丸い下地・プラスの形と光学重みを復元。モックは日本語と14/24の副参照。生成出力を目視し、メンバーを追加/リンクやコードで招待の全文・2行・1本の中立区切り・同じスレート記号・白い面・微かな影・余計な操作なしを確認。同等の招待手段のため飾りの緑を省略。書体の厳密な計測・ベクトル同一性・実招待操作・編集可能性・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
